name: claude-made-stock-bot
description: 基于**FastAPI + WebSocket**的现代化股票分析聊天机器人，集成**Qwen-Coder AI**和**AkShare数据源**，提供实时股票分析、技术指标计算和财务数据查询。支持**CLI命令行**和**Web浏览器**双重使用方式。

scripts.dev: npm run stop && concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:8001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped existing services'
scripts.install: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend:components: echo 'React组件测试需要vitest环境配置'
scripts.test:frontend:hooks: echo 'React Hooks测试需要vitest环境配置'
scripts.test:frontend:vitest: cd tests/frontend && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:js
